checkpoint_payload_note: Original best.pt contains optimizer metadata; it may be loaded safely but must never be used for optimization, resumption or selection.

proposed_execution.cost_limit_note: Estimate covers allocated GPU/CPU/RAM at listed rates; image-build and lifecycle charges need a separate bound before approval.

measurement_proposal.query_order: same frozen measured order for both methods and all passes
measurement_proposal.cold_start: separate record; excluded from warm per-query gate
separate_stages: CPU tensor construction and existing 13-feature preprocessing
measurement_proposal.primary_latency_proposal: synchronized per-query wall time for the entire online fusion path after retriever scores are in RAM; no file I/O or retriever extraction
measurement_proposal.primary_latency_statistic: median across unique measured queries of each query median across 3 passes
measurement_proposal.secondary_latency: p95 across per-query medians, raw per-pass p50/p95, paired QPAF-minus-QARF
measurement_proposal.cuda_timing: CUDA events, synchronize before wall start and after the timed CUDA work
measurement_proposal.memory: reset CUDA peak stats per isolated method process; report allocated/reserved peaks and CPU RSS separately, include model and live fusion tensors, exclude retrievers
measurement_proposal.page_vs_document_scope: active ViDoSeek pilot is page-level; document aggregation is not silently added
measurement_proposal.model_compatibility: verify frozen weights and GPU-vs-pinned-CPU validation scores <=1e-7 before timing

review_decisions_required: Allow label-free text/score access for 172 held-out query IDs, without labels, fitting or selection.
Confirm the full online fusion latency interpretation and page-level ranking scope.
Review the proposed 3 passes, Modal A10 runtime and bounded resource budget.
before_execution_required: immutable runtime image and exact source commit
Research Lead authorization with external manifest SHA256 pin
